AssistantAudioDone.description: No more audio for this reply.
AssistantAudioDone.title: AssistantAudioDone

AssistantAudioStarted.description:
The tutor's voice for this reply follows as binary frames: PCM16 little-endian, mono, at
`sample_rate`, sentence by sentence as the reply is generated.
AssistantAudioStarted.title: AssistantAudioStarted

ConnectionTestResult.description: Body of `POST /v1/llm/test`. A failed test is a normal result (`ok=False`), not an error.
ConnectionTestResult.title: ConnectionTestResult

Correction.description: Feedback on the learner's message. `corrected == text` and no items: nothing to fix.
Correction.title: Correction

InputCommit.description:
The learner finished speaking (push-to-talk released): transcribe the audio sent so far.

Audio travels before this event as binary frames: PCM16 little-endian, mono, 16 kHz
(`vt_contracts.audio`).
InputCommit.title: InputCommit

InputInterrupt.description: Stop the tutor's current reply (the learner started a new turn or pressed stop).
InputInterrupt.title: InputInterrupt

InputText.description: A typed message from the learner.
InputText.title: InputText

LearnerProfile.description: What the learner can change from the UI. Body of `PUT /v1/learner`.
LearnerProfile.title: LearnerProfile

ModelList.description: Body of `POST /v1/llm/models`: model ids exactly as the provider expects them, sorted.
ModelList.title: ModelList

ModelStatus.description: Whether one speech server answers and has its model.
ModelStatus.title: ModelStatus

ProblemDetail.description: Error body (`{"detail": ...}`), as FastAPI's `HTTPException` renders it.
ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail

ProviderConnection.description: Enough to reach a provider: body of `POST /v1/llm/models`.
ProviderConnection.title: ProviderConnection

ProviderInfo.description: One entry of `GET /v1/llm/providers`: what the settings form needs to render a preset.
ProviderInfo.title: ProviderInfo

ProviderSettingsInput.description:
Body of `PUT /v1/llm/settings`: save this provider and make it the active one.

`api_key`: `None` keeps the saved key, `""` removes it, anything else replaces it.
ProviderSettingsInput.title: ProviderSettingsInput

ProviderSettingsView.description: A provider's saved settings, without the key.
ProviderSettingsView.title: ProviderSettingsView

SessionStart.description: Begin a conversation. Level and explanation language come from the learner profile.
SessionStart.title: SessionStart

SessionUpdate.description:
Change session options. Applies from the next reply: to silence the current one, the
client stops playing it.
SessionUpdate.title: SessionUpdate

TranscriptFinal.description: What the learner said (or typed) in this turn, as the server will use it.
TranscriptFinal.title: TranscriptFinal

TurnMetrics.description:
Latency of the tutor's reply, in milliseconds, from the learner's message (Phase 0).

Sent once the reply is complete, its audio included. For a spoken turn, the voice-to-voice
latency is `transcript.final.stt_ms + first_audio_ms`.
TurnMetrics.title: TurnMetrics

get.description: Liveness only. Readiness (every model endpoint reachable) arrives with the container.

post.description: The provider's models. POST because the body may carry an API key.

get.description: Every supported provider, in display order.

schema.title: Response List Providers V1 Llm Providers Get

delete.description: Forget the settings saved from the UI, API keys included; the environment applies.

put.description: Save a provider's settings and make it the active one.

post.description: Ask the model for one short sentence and time it.

delete.description:
Stops the download of `key`; nothing to do once it has ended, and 409 while another model
downloads.

post.description: Starts the download in the background; poll `GET /models` for its progress.
A short sentence in the chosen voice, as a WAV.

get.description:
Whether each speech server answers and has the model a conversation would use: the
selected one, or the default while the selected one is not installed. Speech-to-text for
the learner's voice, text-to-speech for the tutor's.

schema.title: Response Get Voices V1 Speech Voices Get
